title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
summary: HiRO-ACEv2 是一个面向 extreme weather 的 AI downscaling 模型，可在 3 km resolution 生成模拟，并以传统高分辨率动力模式一小部分成本运行。

tech_highlights: Generative AI downscaling to 3 km resolution for extreme weather events
Large reduction in computational cost compared with physics-based high-resolution models
Open model release on Hugging Face for reproducible research
analysis.score_reason: 将高分辨率极端天气模拟成本大幅降低，并提供开放权重，对气候风险评估和下游应用具有较高实用价值。
